title: Clipboard
description: Copy values to the clipboard, read it back and see how pages can change or block a paste.

errors.unavailable: The Clipboard API is not available. It needs a secure context (HTTPS or localhost) and a browser that supports it.
errors.permission-denied: Permission to use the clipboard was denied. Grant the clipboard permission, and make sure the page has focus.
errors.unknown: An unknown error occurred while using the clipboard

copy.title: Copy values
copy.explanation: Each button copies its value to the clipboard.

paste.title: Read the clipboard
paste.explanation: Reads the text on the clipboard and shows it below.
paste.empty: The clipboard is empty or holds no text

paste-handling.title: Paste handling
paste-handling.explanation: These fields change what happens when text is pasted into them.
paste-handling.notes-label: Notes (pasted text is cleaned up into plain text)
paste-handling.notes-formatting-removed: Pasted as plain text: the formatting was removed
paste-handling.paste-blocked: Pasting is not allowed here. Type the password again.

copy-blocked.title: Blocked copying
copy-blocked.explanation: Both fields hold the same reference, but copying from the second one is blocked.
copy-blocked.blocked: Copying from this field is not allowed
